text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete for rollout/2026-03-15/runtime-optimizations -> canary (10% traffic). Image: runtime:v2.3.4
incident-bot: Alerts: p99 latency spike on canary pool (us-west-2) > 2500ms for text-gen routes. 12 alerts in 5m. Paging alice_oncall.
alice_oncall: looking now, thanks. pulling up canary dashboards.
ben_runtime: I see immediate increase in KV cache miss rate and a bunch of kernels falling back to 'generic_matmul' on a subset of gpus. probably the kernel selector picked a bad path.
cara_sre: noticing sustained batching queue length increase too. tail latency on small requests skyrocketed. Could be continuous batching not matching new scheduling heuristic.
dan_csm: any customer-visible errors? getting an inbound from vendor-platform about timeouts.
eve_product: we have two high-volume tenants on canary: Acme and Nimbus. need impact estimate ASAP.
ben_runtime: checking model variant routing — canary is serving a slightly different quantized variant. kernel fallback log: ```[2026-03-15T15:12:03Z] model=redwood-small-q4 kernel_selector: fallback_to=generic_matmul reason=unsupported_tile_size device=rtx-a100-1```
ben_runtime: that fallback increases per-token compute by ~3x. explains throughput drop.
alice_oncall: can you repro locally or on a spare canary node?
ben_runtime: repro on spare node with the canary image, yes. Reproducer snippet: ```python
# stress test
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-small-q4-canary', prompt='hello', max_new_tokens=64)
measure(resp.latency)
```
frank_engops: I'm prepping a kill-flag to disable the new kernel selector on canary. publishing flag: runtime.disable_new_kernel_selector=true -> scope=canary. standby for toggle.
alice_oncall: also consider throttling canary traffic back to 0% while we assess.
frank_engops: toggled flag to true on canary at 15:24Z. response: 200 OK. Applying to all nodes in pool.
cara_sre: batch queue length dropping already. nice. p95 reduced from 1.1s -> 430ms after flag.
dan_csm: initial customer reports: Acme saw ~20% request errors for ~18mins; Nimbus reported elevated latency but no errors. I'll open postmortem tickets and notify reps.
eve_product: do we need a rollback of the canary image to v2.3.3?
ben_runtime: two options: keep kill-flag and iterate, or rollback image. kill-flag is safer for now; it avoids traffic shift. we should still rollback if we can't land a fix in 1-2 hours.
frank_engops: marking canary traffic back to normal but flag on. monitoring will catch regressions.
incident-bot: Incident severity: sev2 (partial customer impact). triggered at 2026-03-15T15:12:03Z, mitigated by feature-flag at 2026-03-15T15:24:00Z.
alice_oncall: handoff to ben_runtime and cara_sre for root cause and fix. I'm going offline but will check summary later. @ben_runtime @cara_sre owning.
ben_runtime: initial hypothesis: new kernel-selection heuristic doesn't handle quantized q4 layout when sequence lengths < 32, causing tile misalignment and fallback. reproduction test shows failures on short prompts.
cara_sre: action items: 1) run canary-wide regression test for short-seq workloads 2) add guard in selector to avoid fallback for q4 until validated 3) add metric for fallback counts per model variant 4) postmortem + customer comms (dan_csm).
dan_csm: customer impact note for comms: Acme: 18m errors, ~3% of their requests failed; Nimbus: 12m elevated p95 to ~800ms. We'll coordinate with customer success for follow-ups.
eve_product: prioritize guard and metric. We should treat this as a release gating failure.
ben_runtime: working on small patch to selector logic, will test on spare nodes. ETA 60-90m. If tests pass we can remove kill-flag and re-run staged canary at 5% then 10%.
cara_sre: I'll add an automated alarm for kernel_fallback_rate > 0.1% over 5m so we catch similar regressions earlier.
frank_engops: documenting the kill-flag toggle and rollback plan in the deploy runbook.
alice_oncall: leaving final log: mitigation in place (kill-flag), partial customer impact, ownership -> ben_runtime/cara_sre, follow-up postmortem and comms.
incident-bot: Note: create incident ticket INC-2026-0315-048 and assign to eng-runtime.
ben_runtime: acknowledged, will attach repro logs and fix PR link when ready.
dan_csm: I'll draft initial external note for affected customers and coordinate with legal if needed.
eve_product: thanks everyone. postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause, why QA missed short-seq case, fix, validation plan, and rollback gating.
cara_sre: uploading relevant graphs and logs to the incident ticket. will ping when runbook updated.
alice_oncall: Thanks team — handoff complete. I'll be reachable if anything escalates. :white_check_mark:
